community_note.text: Readers added context they thought people might want to know. The Thrrm Subcommittee for Automaton-Adjacent Determinations (Regulatory Authority 7-Phi, established 2844) has been tasked with adjudicating the ontological and regulatory status of the Mover units and the entities designated Drifters since its establishment. As of 3017, no final determination has been issued. The subcommittee's membership rotates on a 40-year cycle. Former members report elevated stress markers and have formed what is colloquially known as 'the support group that does not officially exist.' [1][2][3][4][5]
